name: macosicons-raycast
title: MacOSicons.com
description: Change the app icon of thousands of macOS apps directly from Raycast, browse all the icons from macOSicons.com.
author: elias_ruiz_monserrat

commands.name: macosicons
commands.title: Search MacOSicons
commands.description: Search and browse app icons from macOSicons.com.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
